game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar, an altar half-sunk in earth: the scholar mage must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Merge Convoy: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar: an altar half-sunk in earth
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunken Altar, repeat each round: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys. Each round, rune wisps strike the moon altar, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the convoy_size value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the moon altar from rune wisps in Sunken Altar: keep the convoy_size meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: convoy_size drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Merge Convoy
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Merge Convoy' (Week 7 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sunken Altar'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how convoy_size changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Sunken Altar.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while convoy_size > 0.
